correctness.rationale: The language is factorial. Incremental prefix enumeration is therefore exhaustive, and every newly created cube is a suffix. Complement avoidance for all lengths at least 6 is exactly equivalent to avoiding complementary pairs of length 6. A second whole-candidate engine independently rescans every cube factor and all length-6 factors; the two engines agree on every level through length 51, with 16 survivors at length 50 and none at 51. Each boundary word is additionally checked at every complementary-factor length 6 through 50, and exact symmetry closure gives four size-4 orbits.
